stem: A customer clicked a display ad 60 days before ordering, a social ad 12 days before and an email 1 day before. Voltmarkt counts only touches in the 30 days up to and including the order. Under first click, which channel gets the order?

options.text: Social, the first touch inside the window
Display, the first touch the customer ever made
Email, the touch closest to the order itself
Display and social, half each, as both opened a visit
